author: Aydran
body:
Hello boys and gurls,
I present you VoxelSniper and WorldEdit building notes, these notes include most commands and a few helpful resources to guide you in your map making adventure. And without further to do since there is not much to explain Gowaii <3

VoxelSniper Notes: http://pastebin.com/ah36mQCQ

WorldEdit Notes: http://pastebin.com/NWEBZjBX

Plugin Downloads:
VoxelSniper
WorldEdit

And now you can create your epic creations :)

-Adrian <3
